exercises.instruction: Label the pictures with the different ways of cooking.
Fill the gaps in these sentences with the correct noun, verb or adjective.
items: 1  You will need to put the meat in the ................................. for half an hour at 200 degrees centigrade, then reduce the temperature to 180 for the rest of the cooking time.
3  If you are cooking steak, you need to turn up the ................................. so that your pan i[?] really hot before you put the meat in.
4  When I pay for my meal, I usually leave 10% for the waiter if .................................. is no[?] included.
6  The trouble with fattening food is that it makes you ................................. weight if you're not very careful.
7  Have you asked the waiter for the ................................. and the wine list?
8  I'm not very keen on curry: it's too hot and ................................. for me.
9  The chicken is cooked in a white wine and cream ................................. .
10  It's a very simple restaurant but the food is delicious and everything is .................................-made.
